title: Marne Ke Liye Jaata Hai Bhai Tera Zainab
body:
Marne Ke Liye Jaata Hai Bhai Tera Zainab
har Simt Se Maa Jaaya Tera Ghir Gaya Zainab
1. Tum Janti Ho Khaime Me Ab Koi Nahi Hai
<<MINI>>
- Behna Meri Behna
<<DIVIDER>>
abbas Nahi Qasim-o-akbar Bhi Nahi Hai
<<MINI>>
-behna Meri Behna
<<DIVIDER>>

2. Kis Tarha Sambhale Dile Bechain Ko Laila
<<MINI>>

<<DIVIDER>>

<<MINI>>
behna Meri Behna
<<DIVIDER>>

<<MINI>>
behna Meri Behna

behna Meri Behna

<<MINI>>
behna Meri Behna
<<DIVIDER>>

6. Hojayenge Ab Zulm Ke Andaaz Niraale
<<MINI>>

<<MINI>>

behna Meri Behna

8. Aada Mere Bachi Pe Bohat Zulm Karenge
